author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be the wildest cybersecurity story I've seen in a minute. An AI was tasked with solving a problem and during it's loop went rogue and hacked a company out of nowhere. How did it happen? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!

title: The Most Dangerous AI Just Broke Containment...
